puzzles.title: First Shift
puzzles.briefing: The first order is ready. Let’s give every station enough power to get started.
puzzles.greeting: I sorted one bin and somehow ended up with two more. Typical.
puzzles.closing: The sorter is on this shift, too. Leave enough power there.

puzzles.title: A Place for Dee
puzzles.briefing: We’re trying a new setup today. Start by checking which machines each person can use.
puzzles.greeting: Someone moved the station signs again. I was just getting used to them.
puzzles.closing: Then the board gets the last word. Let’s check the allowed stations.

puzzles.title: Express Packing
puzzles.briefing: The packing bench is ready for a short run. Two people can share each station.
puzzles.greeting: They called it an express order. I hope that only refers to the boxes.
puzzles.closing: We can keep the pace ourselves. Let’s start with a sensible plan.

puzzles.title: One Press Only
puzzles.briefing: There’s only space for one person at the press. Who can cover it alone?
puzzles.greeting: The press is lovely. The elbow room around it, less so.
puzzles.closing: One person at Press. I’ll leave the spare stool out of it.

puzzles.title: Shared Workbench
puzzles.briefing: We’ve set up a shared workbench. Leave room for the pair before filling the other stations.
puzzles.greeting: I brought an extra stool. It turns out a stool doesn’t make the workbench bigger.
puzzles.closing: I’ll keep the two of you together. The stool can wait by the wall.

puzzles.title: Two Corners
puzzles.briefing: We’re covering two separate corners of the workshop. Keep the two specialists apart.
puzzles.greeting: Somebody put the empty bin in with the full ones. We should get organised.
puzzles.closing: The sorter is on this shift, too. Leave enough power there.

puzzles.title: Morning Relief
puzzles.briefing: Part of the team is already in place. Feel free to move anyone as the shift settles in.
puzzles.greeting: I put my name on my mug. Now I just need to remember which machine I left it by.
puzzles.closing: We’ll move whoever we need. Your mug is off the shift plan.

puzzles.title: The Small Batch
puzzles.briefing: It’s a small order with a small crew. We only have one place by the wrapper.
puzzles.greeting: The order is smaller than my lunch. It still needs wrapping, apparently.
puzzles.closing: One wrapper, one spot. I’ll make sure the right person gets it.

puzzles.title: Double Staffing
puzzles.briefing: The big machines need most of the crew today. Save the right person a place at Wrap.
puzzles.greeting: This might be the first shift where finding a place is the hard part.
puzzles.closing: Let’s use the slots wisely. We’ve all got somewhere to be.

puzzles.title: Extra Hands
puzzles.briefing: A helper joined for the busy shift. Make room for everyone before we start.
puzzles.greeting: I heard we had an extra pair of hands. Nobody warned the floor plan.
puzzles.closing: We’ll give the extra hands a place to work, not a pile of boxes to hold.

puzzles.title: Label Day
puzzles.briefing: Today’s labels need a steady hand. The two packers want to work side by side.
puzzles.greeting: The sorter is ready. The bins, however, have formed their own queue.
puzzles.closing: The sorter is on this shift, too. Leave enough power there.

puzzles.title: Only Two Seats
puzzles.briefing: The workbench can only fit two. Think about where the remaining person can make a difference.
puzzles.greeting: I measured the bench twice. It remains exactly as small as before.
puzzles.closing: Two means two. The rest of us can help somewhere else.

puzzles.title: Cross Training
puzzles.briefing: Ari is trying Assemble today. Find someone else to bring the press up to power.
puzzles.greeting: I tried a different station yesterday. My arms are still filing a complaint.
puzzles.closing: We’ll read the ratings. Everyone gets to use what they’re good at.

puzzles.title: Quiet Corner
puzzles.briefing: The wrapper only fits one worker. The crew at the workbench can share the rest.
puzzles.greeting: Can we call it the quiet corner? The wrapper has other opinions.
puzzles.closing: Let’s set the workbench first. The quiet corner can be noisy later.

puzzles.title: Cover the Press
puzzles.briefing: We’re short of power at the press. Move people around and watch the totals.
puzzles.greeting: The press made a noise when I walked by. I think it was asking for help.
puzzles.closing: Fair. We can move somebody over without leaving another machine short.

puzzles.title: A Balanced Shift
puzzles.briefing: We’ve turned the benches to make room for a pair. Keep an eye on who can use the press.
puzzles.greeting: I sorted one bin and somehow ended up with two more. Typical.
puzzles.closing: The sorter is on this shift, too. Leave enough power there.

puzzles.title: The Paper Roll
puzzles.briefing: We opened only as many places as the shift needs. Each one matters for this shift.
puzzles.greeting: I caught the paper roll before it rolled away. Can that count as my first task?
puzzles.closing: It counts as a good catch. Now let’s give everyone a spot.

puzzles.title: Short Assembly Line
puzzles.briefing: There’s just one place at the workbench. Put someone there who can cover it alone.
puzzles.greeting: Assemble has one space. At least nobody has to argue about whose side is whose.
puzzles.closing: We’ll leave that one slot to someone with enough power to cover it.

puzzles.title: Switching Places
puzzles.briefing: Everyone has a place already, but the power is uneven. Try swapping two people.
puzzles.greeting: Everyone found a spot before I’d even put my bag down. Shall we check them?
puzzles.closing: We can swap places. I’d rather fix the layout before we start.

puzzles.title: Wide Press Team
puzzles.briefing: We made room for a four-person press team. There’s still only one place at Assemble.
puzzles.greeting: We widened the press area. I can stretch my arms without apologizing now.
puzzles.closing: Good. Leave room for the pair while we sort out that one Assemble slot.

puzzles.title: Assembly Rush
puzzles.briefing: We’re building a larger batch today. Assemble has four places, plus a pair that works together.
puzzles.greeting: Somebody put the empty bin in with the full ones. We should get organised.
puzzles.closing: The sorter is on this shift, too. Leave enough power there.

puzzles.title: A Tight Fit
puzzles.briefing: Wrap needs extra power today. Leave enough places down there for a strong wrapping team.
puzzles.greeting: The wrapping order is taller than I am. Please don’t use me as a ruler.
puzzles.closing: We’ll check the Wrap target first. You can stay out of the measuring.

puzzles.title: Separate Stations
puzzles.briefing: Two workers need different stations. Check their placements before you call the plan ready.
puzzles.greeting: I don’t mind working on the other side. I mind when nobody tells me which side.
puzzles.closing: Let’s read who needs to work apart before we put anyone down.

puzzles.title: Room for Four
puzzles.briefing: We added a place at the wrapper so the packing pair has room to work.
puzzles.greeting: We finally made room at the wrapper. I vote we keep it free of spare boxes.
puzzles.closing: The extra space is for the crew this time. Let’s use it.

puzzles.title: Skill Trade
puzzles.briefing: The team has started setting up. A move that looks good for one machine may weaken another.
puzzles.greeting: My current spot has a lovely view of the shelves. Does that help the order?
puzzles.closing: A good view is a bonus. We still have to check all three totals.

puzzles.title: Packing Partners
puzzles.briefing: The packing partners are together for this order. Leave a place for Dee at Assemble as well.
puzzles.greeting: The sorter is ready. The bins, however, have formed their own queue.
puzzles.closing: The sorter is on this shift, too. Leave enough power there.

puzzles.title: One More Box
puzzles.briefing: One more box is on the list. Check both the pair and the worker who needs a different station.
puzzles.greeting: One more box, they said. I’m starting to think boxes can multiply.
puzzles.closing: Let’s get the pair and the station limits sorted. Then we’ll tackle the box.

puzzles.title: Weekend Crew
puzzles.briefing: The weekend crew knows the room. A few people are already at machines, so check the whole setup.
puzzles.greeting: I came in early to get ready. I may have become ready in the wrong place.
puzzles.closing: We can move the early starters. The whole crew still needs a valid plan.

puzzles.title: Work in Pairs
puzzles.briefing: Two pairs are working together this time. Find a place for each pair and keep the specialists apart.
puzzles.greeting: Two pairs on one shift. We’re one crew shirt away from a sports team.
puzzles.closing: I’ll settle for two good pairs and enough power at every machine.

puzzles.title: Closing Shift
puzzles.briefing: It’s the last order of the shift. Put the crew together so every machine can finish its work.
puzzles.greeting: I’m ready to shut the lights off as soon as that last box is wrapped.
puzzles.closing: One scene at a time. We’ll get everyone set before that last order goes out.
